<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#000000"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="316" y1="14" x2="316" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="321" y1="11" x2="321" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="326" y1="8" x2="326" y2="18" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="344" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="14" x2="347" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="359" y="9" width="19" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="361" y="11" width="13" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="378" y="12" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Top app bar -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="28,53 21,60 28,67" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="60" x2="38" y2="60" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="52" y="56" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#87898C">SHARED LANGUAGE</text>
    <text x="52" y="76" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Choose a lens</text>
    <circle cx="357" cy="59" r="14" fill="#111111" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="351" y1="59" x2="363" y2="59" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="357" y1="53" x2="357" y2="65" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Purple dashed design boundary -->
  <rect x="14" y="94" width="362" height="664" rx="8" fill="none" stroke="#7B61FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7 6"/>
  <text x="28" y="115" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="#9A69E5" letter-spacing="1">REFLECTIVE PRACTICE • 01</text>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="145" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="24.38" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Either / Or</text>
    <text x="28" y="167" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">or Both / And?</text>
    <text x="28" y="190" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Notice the story your first response creates.</text>
    <text x="28" y="207" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Select the thinking style you want to explore.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Option one shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="224" width="336" height="151" rx="8" fill="#45413C" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="27" y="222" width="336" height="151" rx="8" fill="#111111" stroke="#8A3FFC" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="253" r="22" fill="#8A3FFC"/>
    <!-- custom split icon -->
    <line x1="57" y1="240" x2="57" y2="266" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="48,246 54,246 54,242" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polyline points="66,260 60,260 60,264" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="253" r="27" fill="none" stroke="#8A3FFC" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.45"/>
    <text x="92" y="248" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Either Or Thinking</text>
    <rect x="92" y="258" width="62" height="20" rx="5" fill="#8A3FFC"/>
    <text x="103" y="272" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">SELECTED</text>
    <text x="43" y="304" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12.94" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Complex questions become two opposing</text>
    <text x="43" y="322" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12.94" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">choices: right or wrong, success or failure.</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="341" x2="347" y2="341" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="359" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10.35" font-weight="400" fill="#BDA7FF">A familiar shortcut • can limit possibility</text>
    <circle cx="339" cy="244" r="9" fill="#8A3FFC"/>
    <polyline points="334,244 338,248 345,240" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Option two shadow and card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="27" y="391" width="336" height="151" rx="8" fill="#45413C" opacity="0.45"/>
    <rect x="27" y="389" width="336" height="151" rx="8" fill="#111111" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="420" r="22" fill="#08BDBA"/>
    <!-- custom both and icon -->
    <circle cx="51" cy="420" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="63" cy="420" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="57" y1="408" x2="57" y2="432" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="92" y="416" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="18.28" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Both And Thinking</text>
    <rect x="92" y="427" width="47" height="20" rx="5" fill="#08BDBA"/>
    <text x="103" y="441" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">OPEN</text>
    <text x="43" y="473" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12.94" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Makes room for tension, context, and</text>
    <text x="43" y="491" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12.94" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">more than one true experience at once.</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="510" x2="347" y2="510" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="528" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10.35" font-weight="400" fill="#72E9E7">A wider invitation • holds complexity</text>
    <circle cx="339" cy="410" r="9" fill="#000000" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Reflection panel -->
  <g>
    <text x="28" y="577" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="16.18" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Try a reframe</text>
    <text x="28" y="596" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">What could be true at the same time?</text>
    <rect x="28" y="610" width="334" height="53" rx="8" fill="#111111" stroke="#45413C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="632" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Type a thought to revisit later…</text>
    <line x1="43" y1="646" x2="347" y2="646" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="43" y="657" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9.06" font-weight="400" fill="#656769">PRIVATE REFLECTION</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="28" y="681" width="160" height="39" rx="8" fill="#8A3FFC"/>
      <text x="108" y="706" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="198" y="681" width="164" height="39" rx="8" fill="#000000" stroke="#6E7191" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="280" y="706" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Save for later</text>
    </g>
    <text x="28" y="741" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="10.35" font-weight="400" fill="#656769">Updated today • 2 min reflection</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="777" width="390" height="67" fill="#111111"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="777" x2="390" y2="777" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,801 49,793 59,801 59,812 52,812 52,805 46,805 46,812 39,812" fill="none" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="49" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9.06" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Home</text>
    <circle cx="126" cy="801" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="808" x2="138" y2="814" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="126" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9.06" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Explore</text>
    <rect x="190" y="793" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="#8A3FFC"/>
    <polygon points="195,808 198,808 195,813" fill="#8A3FFC"/>
    <text x="200" y="803" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">2</text>
    <text x="200" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9.06" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Practice</text>
    <circle cx="274" cy="799" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <ellipse cx="274" cy="810" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="274" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9.06" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Profile</text>
    <circle cx="345" cy="801" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="345" cy="801" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="788" x2="345" y2="791" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="811" x2="345" y2="814" stroke="#87898C" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="345" y="829" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Atkinson Hyperlegible, sans-serif" font-size="9.06" font-weight="400" fill="#87898C">Settings</text>
  </g>
</svg>
